coverage.reason: Reduce Inner Castle dragging and zooming work by coalescing pointer/wheel paints, caching fixed-size labels, reading fixed panels before camera writes and batching construction timer geometry. Preserve every input delta and per-event bounds, accessible building selection, artwork sharpness, district anchors, construction overlays, resource refresh and equipment return. The browser regression exercises frame/layout budgets under 4x CPU slowdown, real pointer capture with high-rate drag bursts, boundary reversal, queued-work cancellation, resize/text/font cache invalidation and no idle work. Existing native input, timer and refresh checks cover shared dependencies; actual-game integration covers production delivery and lifecycle. Source and built fixtures run at desktop and two landscape-mobile sizes. Static checks preserve artwork and estate integration contracts; the previous blanket animation-frame ban is replaced by idle/teardown behavior checks. No server, gameplay balance, saved state, current realm data or release contract changes, so no emulator suites are needed.
